patches.summary: Sign Onshape API-key requests with the documented HMAC headers and accept the user's API-key env aliases.
patches.reason: The generated CLI read access/secret keys but emitted no usable Authorization header, so live API calls could not be validated honestly during Phase 5.
patches.validated_outcome: Live document search, workspace/version listing, element listing, assembly get, parts list, and full Phase 5 dogfood passed with real credentials.

patches.summary: Replace placeholder help examples with known-good Onshape fixture IDs and cap sync pagination at Onshape's 20-item limit.
patches.reason: The full live dogfood runner executes help examples; placeholder UUIDs produced false live failures, and Onshape rejects document list limits above 20.
patches.validated_outcome: Full live dogfood passed: 90/90 counted tests, 0 failures.
